messages:
Priya: quick check — opened PR #3784 to tidy a couple of helper names and drop an unused var. CI is green except the fmt check on one file (windows eol?)
Alex: saw that, left one tiny naming suggestion — nothing blocking. can merge as soon as fmt is resolved and one more 👍
Marco: I can approve once the fmt step is clean. curious which file is tripping it though.
ci-bot: fmt-check failed on files: `pkg/runner/exec_windows.go` — detected CRLF. Command output:
```
gofmt -l .
pkg/runner/exec_windows.go
```
Suggested fix: normalize EOLs or run `gofmt -w`.
Janet: this repo has `gitattributes` but some people still commit CRLF. easiest path: run `dos2unix pkg/runner/exec_windows.go` then `gofmt -w` and force-push. small follow-up: we should add a pre-commit hook in devex to auto-fix.
Priya: thanks — I'll run the dos2unix + gofmt and push. then @Alex can do the approval. I'll also open a tiny ops PR to add a pre-commit that runs `gofmt -w` and normalizes eol for .go files.
Alex: sounds good. one more nit I left about a var name (`ctxID` -> `requestID`) — feel free to apply in this PR if trivial, otherwise we can do it in a quick follow-up.
Priya: it's trivial, will adjust in the same push.
Marco: ping me if CI still flakes after your push, I can rerun and approve.
Priya: pushed the fix (force push). changed var name and ran `gofmt -w`. CI queued.
ci-bot: all checks passed — fmt, unit-tests (linux), integration.
Merge allowed: yes.
Alex: approving now. :thumbsup:
Alex: note for the follow-up pre-commit PR — let's include instructions to run `git config core.autocrlf input` in the README to reduce future CRLFs.
Priya: good call. I'll include that in the pre-commit PR and add a one-line note in the dev onboarding doc.
Marco: merging when green. thanks everyone.
Priya: merged. closing thread. :tada:
